name: byte-as-int-test-3342351ff8/byte-as-int-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.array lists length, push, map, indexOf, remove, removeAll, toStream, toBase64, toBase16, fromBase64, fromBase16.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: array:length, array:push, array:map, array:indexOf, array:remove, array:removeAll, array:toStream, array:toBase64, array:toBase16.
reason: The required testBytesInIntArray execution uses arr.enumerate() to obtain index/value tuples. array:enumerate is absent from both the supported langlib functions and method-call lists, so the whole case requires an unsupported feature.
test_design_notes: main asserts six true output lines and then executes additional assertion-based tests; the unsupported enumerate call is essential to the fourth output. io:println is instrumentation.
